description: This Java class `LegacySecurityDeviceInfoEvent` extends `ClusterCommandEvent` and represents a specific event related to legacy security devices within a Zigbee/mock Zigbee environment. It constructs command payloads containing device firmware version, type, status, configuration, and identification data to be sent as part of a cluster command in Zigbee communication.

classes.name: LegacySecurityDeviceInfoEvent
classes.description: A class representing a Zigbee cluster command event for legacy security devices, capable of constructing a command payload with device information details.

methods.name: LegacySecurityDeviceInfoEvent
methods.description: Constructs a new event with specified EUI64 and endpoint ID, with optional device object.

methods.name: getCommandPayload
methods.description: Generates the payload byte array for the cluster command, encoding device firmware version, type, status, config, and identification data.
